messages.author: 12bc2d6c8000124a
messages.subject: direction of plots
parts:
Is there a way to change the direction of the plots in the output of BioGeoBEARS, similar to the direction="upwards" argument in plot.phylo from the ape package?

Thanks,
Karen

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] direction of plots
parts:
Hi! Short answer is nope! People are welcome to modify the plot function however.  It might almost just work if the direction command was added as the core of it is ape's plot function, however you'd have to make sure the coordinates for nodes and corners are tracked also. 

Simpler solution is to rotate the page in Adobe or whatever...

Cheers!
Nick
